name: Test Environments
description: Reusable local account references, launch profiles and acceptance cases.
whenToUse: Reusable local account references, launch profiles and acceptance cases.

catalog.description: List projects, account references, launch profiles and acceptance cases. No credentials. Call first to choose exact IDs.

save_project.description: Save a project and its argv commands. Commands execute as this computer user. Never store secrets in arguments.

save_account.description: Save a named account reference; the application retains credentials. Existing identity cannot be rebound.

save_profile.description: Save launch settings. Cindy desktop requires isolated storage; legacy preserves the original login flow.

save_case.description: Save ordered acceptance actions and expected outcomes. Saving does not run a test.

remove.description: Remove a catalog entry only. Dependencies must be reassigned first; application data and credentials remain.

import_cindy.description: Import public account aliases from the existing local Cindy dev profile catalog. Never copies credentials.

plan.description: Resolve exact argv and configuration without executing. For mobile, returns simulator handoff; use baguette-simulator on the exact device.

start.description: Start a saved profile action; returns a persistent jobId immediately. Query status, never repeat while waiting. No process-start result proves login.

status.description: Read one job or all jobs, actual readiness and sign-in requirements. Unknown state requires inspection, not blind retry.

stop.description: Stop only this plugin job and its verified owned process. Preserve login and data. Query status until stopped.

inspect.description: Inspect the owned desktop app through its debug port, even while locked. Optionally save a private screenshot; never reads credentials.
